evals.prompt: Make me a smooth deep house groove, about 16 bars, from clips I've rated highly. Send me something to listen to.
evals.expected_output: A new .apr score built around the user's top-rated clips, rendered to audio, with a short by-bars description; smooth and sparse, harmonically fitted.

evals.prompt: Write a sparse 12-bar blues shuffle around 90 bpm with the marine band stems.
evals.expected_output: A 12-bar blues .apr (I7 IV7 V7 form) using marine-band stems, swung, sparse, rendered to audio.
